---
title: "Movie Analysis"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
movies
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(column) sum(is.na(column))))
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ",") |>
  mutate(genre = str_trim(genre))
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audienceScore = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomatoMeter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies |>
  drop_na(tomatoMeter) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
